text:
maya: Quick check — pricing wants to finalise entrance bands for partner onboarding before next week. Two lightweight proposals, need alignment on launch gating.

maya: Proposal A = narrow starter: 2M tokens/mo, no burst, must upgrade for Dedicated. Simpler billing.

maya: Proposal B = elastic starter: 5M tokens/mo + 24hr burst pool up to 20M/mo, higher initial checkout UX complexity but fewer early escalations.

carl: Question — does B break our committed capacity math? if many partners use bursts that could make forecasting noisy.

ashley: Agree with carl. B reduces churn risk but increases ops unpredictability unless we gate burst via priority tokens.

tom: What about a hybrid: B but burst only for 1st 30 days of onboarding, then revert to baseline unless they sign commit? Helps demo without long tail cost.

lena: Legal constraints: we need to avoid implied SLA on burst. If we promise burst, contracts must state "best effort" and not count toward reserved capacity credits. Can draft clause. @legal-bot can confirm.

legal-bot: FYI — we should include explicit limits and non-SLA wording. Also require customers opt-in to burst terms. I can draft opt-in language.

maya: Launch criteria we need: billing events emitted per route, per-token metering validated, telemetry showing <5% cost variance vs forecast for two sample partners, and legal opt-in copy live.

carl: For telemetry: add per-customer rolling-7d unit-cost metric and alarm if deviation >10%. Also confirm meter ingestion latency <60s.

ashley: UX note: the checkout should show "Starter includes 5M tokens/mo. First 30 days includes temporary burst quota" and a link to docs. Minimal wording. PM needs copy.

tom: Implementation blocker: billing tag propagation from edge -> router -> billing pipeline. Eng infra says ~3 work days to add tag and test.

maya: Ok, owners: infra add billing tag (tom), billing pipeline validation (carl), legal opt-in (lena), checkout copy (ashley), telemetry dashboards (carl). Target: ship gating-page + docs by EOD Friday.

lena: I'll draft opt-in & exclusion clause by Thu noon.

carl: I'll instrument rolling cost metric by Thu EOD and push alarm.

ashley: I'll send checkout copy + brief to design tomorrow morning.

tom: Tag work started, ETA Wed afternoon. Will post PR link.

maya: Sweet. If any of the gating criteria can't be met, call for immediate rollback to Proposal A (no burst). Call out blockers asap.

maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
